items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: And he was talking to Sally, man, they were up there talking.

ctx.x: No, Duke liked to navigate. He would-- you know he insisted (inaudible) Harry couldn't have made it if he wasn't telling Harry where to --

Yeah. He was beautiful though. He came up to where I'm playing in Honolulu about a year or so before he passed, you know. And he was talking to Sally, man, they were up there talking. He said -- you know, he had all the flowery words he used. And I play a few of his songs, "Mood Indigo", you know, and that knocked him out, and a few of
those things. He said I didn't know you could use a plunger. I says, oh, yeah. He's lots of fun though.
